## Scope

The audit reviewed 151 second reads taken during 2021 Q3. It assessed the consistency of grading decisions across the material included in the audit. The review was conducted as a quality assurance exercise and focused on the agreement between the original grading and the second-read assessment. The audit findings provide a basis for identifying areas where grading practice may require further attention or clarification.

## Result

Overall agreement was 64.9 per cent. This result represents the level of consistency observed across the audited reads. Per-grader results are provided in the attached spreadsheet for reference. The findings will also be discussed privately with each grader, supporting a clear and constructive review of individual results while maintaining appropriate confidentiality. Any follow-up arising from those discussions will be managed through the usual quality assurance process.
